title: Attach a finite family of nondegenerate simplices to a split truncation
statement: Let $\mathcal D$ be a category with finite limits [def-galois-finite-limits-colimits], and let $n\geq0$. Let $K:\Delta_{\leq n}^{op}\to\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal D)$ be an $n$-truncated simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-coskeleton, def-weil-pbc-formal-coproduct], with $K_q=\{U_{q,i}\}_{i\in I_q}$ and all $I_q$ finite. Assume $K$ is split in the following explicit sense: writing $N_q\subseteq I_q$ for indices not in the image of any operator associated to a surjection $[q]\to[r]$ with $r<q$, the map $\coprod_{0\leq r\leq q,\,\sigma:[q]\twoheadrightarrow[r]}N_r\to I_q$, $(\sigma,i)\mapsto K(\sigma)(i)$, is bijective, and the corresponding component morphisms $U_{r,i}\to U_{q,K(\sigma)(i)}$ are isomorphisms. Let $M$ be the limit in $\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal D)$ of the boundary diagram with objects $K_n^{(a)}$ ($0\leq a\leq n+1$), objects $K_{n-1}^{(a,b)}$ ($a<b$) and arrows $d_{b-1}:K_n^{(a)}\to K_{n-1}^{(a,b)}$, $d_a:K_n^{(b)}\to K_{n-1}^{(a,b)}$ (for $n=0$, just two copies of $K_0$ and no arrows). For any finite family $V=\{V_j\}_{j\in J}$ with a morphism $v:V\to M$, there is a split $(n+1)$-truncated simplicial object $L$ extending $K$, with $L_{n+1}=V\amalg\coprod_{0\leq r\leq n,\,\sigma:[n+1]\twoheadrightarrow[r]}\{U_{r,i}\}_{i\in N_r}$. Its new nondegenerate indices are precisely $J$, its boundary morphism $L_{n+1}\to M$ restricts to $v$ on $V$, and on the summand $(\sigma,i)$ its $a$-th face is the component of $K(\sigma\circ\delta_a)$ on $U_{r,i}$, where $\delta_a:[n]\hookrightarrow[n+1]$ omits $a$. Every term of $L$ has finite index set.
